project.name: Maya
project.description: A multi-channel marketing and communications strategy to generate 2,000+ quality book submissions and build a sustainable author community.
project.primary_objective: Generate 2,000+ quality book submissions from relevant authors.
secondary_objectives: Increase international awareness of Maya Book Awards.
Build a reusable database of authors, writers, publishers, organisations and communities.
Develop recurring partnership and sponsorship opportunities.
Re‑engage previous entrants and existing contacts.
Strengthen social and content presence around authors and books.
Create a long‑term author community and referral network.
Identify potential investors, sponsors and strategic supporters.
success_metrics: Growth in database size and contact quality.
